description: Inclusion of excluded epochs sensitivity analysis (06 v1.1 §4.2, §5); run plan E as corrected by Josue 2026-10-17 (LOG-2026-10-17-ITEM-E-FOLLOW-06). Pre-specified; descriptive (06 §4.4); never assigns or revises the RESULT-001 label.

factors_changed.epochs_added: exactly the three exclusions 06 §4.2 says the sensitivity analysis includes: IED epochs without a reconstructable marker (ied_no_marker), non-IED epochs containing a marker (nonied_marker, kept as negatives under their folder label), and non-IED epochs adjacent to an IED epoch (adjacent). Short, edge, epoch-QC and state exclusions stay (src/data/vepiset_evaluable_recount.classify with lift)
factors_changed.evaluability: R3 recount on this epoch set: >= 5 IED and >= 5 non-IED epochs in a common state, from the cached labels and states only (labels and counts; no model output); group, coverage and therefore the inner folds follow the recount, written to artifacts/exp013/recount_override.json before any fit

unchanged_from_exp004.window: label-blind salience-selected 2-s window on CAR (06 issue 1), as EXP-004
unchanged_from_exp004.epochs_and_exclusions: every other §4.2 exclusion as locked; the cache check requires the primary-rule epochs to reproduce the F-6 recount exactly and every added epoch to carry one of the three lifted reasons
unchanged_from_exp004.fc: wPLI theta/alpha/beta on CAR, §4.3; IAAFT k = 5 per band (D1)
unchanged_from_exp004.learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier, locked grid (16 points), max_iter 300, no early stopping; random_state = repeat seed + outer fold
unchanged_from_exp004.tuning: nested inner CV, mean within-patient same-state AUROC; ties -> simpler
unchanged_from_exp004.estimand: procedure-level within-patient same-state DeltaAUROC, equal patient weight, per-repeat Delta averaged over repeats

learner_note: primary learner only; the LR learner is its own robustness factor (06 §5) and is not crossed
restrict_note: also reported: the same contrast over the 35 EXP-004 evaluable patients only (descriptive)

inference.interval: M1 (06 v1.1 §4.4; RDR-014), 90% and 95%; patient-cluster percentile bootstrap 90%/95% alongside
inference.heterogeneity: R6: SD of Delta_p, 95% prediction interval, range, counts beyond +/- SESOI
inference.state_strata: estimate + 95% percentile bootstrap CI, no outcome label (R10)
inference.pc1: FC-only on this epoch set, M1 95% lower bound of mean AUROC; reported, not a gate here

reading.rule: the seven-rule taxonomy (src/evaluation/taxonomy.classify) applied to the M1 intervals is reported as a descriptive reading of this sensitivity analysis only, never as a label for H-1

concordance.inconclusive: inconclusive (too imprecise to agree or disagree)
